title: LineContinuity_Correlation mode params
description: Detects liquid boundaries as drops in cross-row ridge correlation. Low correlation across a gap = structural discontinuity. Shares extractor params with all LineContinuity modes.

threshold.description: Normalised correlation upper bound — troughs (low values) below this threshold are candidates. Note: inverted relative to other modes (low correlation = candidate).

min_distance.description: Minimum pixel distance between adjacent candidates.
